families.name: Homogeneous dimension and fixed-r coefficient estimate
families.scope: The printed value overcounts homogeneous monomials; both grow polynomially for fixed r. No dimension-uniform l1 bound is asserted.

families.name: Normalized Haar orthogonality and Parseval
families.scope: An attributed explanation of Remark 4.3 for fixed finite r; no claim to prove the separate dimension-uniform Bohnenblust-Hille theorem.

families.name: Real versus complex polynomial evaluation
families.scope: The real rectangle and complex polydisc differ; the power example cannot refute the complex symmetric-tensor theorem.

families.name: Symmetrization quotient versus restricted l1 norm
families.scope: A contractive averaging projection explains Lemma 3.16; this is not an exact equality between injective and projective norms.

families.name: Commutativity in the spectral-radius seminorm
families.scope: The section-ring application is commutative; spectral radius is not a seminorm for arbitrary noncommutative Banach algebras.

families.name: Klt integrability and bounded-above weights
families.scope: Integrability is not pointwise finiteness on the divisor; quasi-psh upper boundedness does not give a lower bound.

families.name: Narasimhan-Simha Hölder exponents
families.scope: Submultiplicativity applies before convexification; the convex hull product uses all pairs of decomposition pieces. External uniform convergence remains attributed.

families.name: Gauss projection and degree-zero caveats
families.scope: A blanket product-divisorial projection needs the trivial restriction; F^0R=0 after shifting concerns positive-degree pieces, not the unital degree-zero summand.

families.name: Raw NA FS versus canonical usc extension
families.scope: A literal all-semivaluation raw (6.15) is not the decreasing-net PSH function. It agrees with the canonical extension on divisorial tests; no counterexample to the intended canonical ray theorem is claimed.

families.name: Veronese original-degree volume calibration
families.scope: Canonical approximation volume must divide native volume by k or rescale filtration weights. This repairs notation rather than refuting intended continuity.

families.name: Integer rounding and fixed-time errors
families.scope: Rounding preserves multiplicativity and asymptotic fixed-time rays, not finite exact norms or uniform bounds for t unbounded.

families.name: One-sided compact-support moment determination
families.scope: The common sign shift in Theorem 6.4 is essential when recovering a full compactly supported law from absolute moments.

families.name: Degree-k line-bundle typing
families.scope: The test-configuration extension of an L^k section is in mathcal L^k; all-small-degree central-fibre base change remains a separate premise.

families.name: Ordered energy-distance algebra
families.scope: The source distance subtraction follows two ordered chains; it is not a general triangle-inequality identity or arbitrary limsup subtraction.
